para.dtcname: Smart Lock and Unlock Do Not Operate from Any Door (Wireless Function Operates)

content5.ptxt: If the door locks operate lock <-> unlock by wireless operation, the communication circuit between the door control receiver <-> smart key computer assembly (certification ECU) is normal. If operation by smart operation is not possible, the smart cancel function may have been set by customization, communication between the electrical key transmitter <-> vehicle may not be possible in the smart communication circuit, or radio interference may be the cause.

item.ptxt: The Smart Entry & Start System (smart entry) has functions that use multiplex communication. First, follow "How to Proceed with Troubleshooting" and confirm that there is no malfunction in the communication system before proceeding with troubleshooting.
When using TaSCAN with the ignition switch OFF, repeatedly turn any door courtesy light switch ON←→OFF until communication between TaSCAN and the vehicle starts. (ON←→OFF interval within 1.5 seconds)
When the electrical key transmitter (electronic key) or smart key computer assembly (certification ECU) is replaced, refer to the immobiliser registration procedure in the reference section.
Check that there are no other electrical key transmitters in the vehicle interior.

test1.ptxt: Check that the door locks operate lock <-> unlock when the door control switch of the power window regulator master switch assembly is operated.

test1.ptxt: Move the electrical key transmitter as follows and check the operation.

item.ptxt: Holding the electrical key transmitter close to the door outside handle or electrical key antenna makes it less susceptible to radio interference, so it can be determined whether radio interference is the cause.
The radio waves transmitted for wireless operation and smart operation are the same, but because the signal logic differs, either one may be affected by radio interference.

test2.ptxt: Hold the electronic key close to the driver side door outside handle and check the smart lock/unlock operation from the driver side door.

atten3.ptxt: Communication is not possible within 20cm of the door handle.

test2.ptxt: Hold the electrical key transmitter close to the front passenger side door outside handle and check the smart lock <-> unlock operation from the front passenger side door.

atten3.ptxt: Communication is not possible within 20cm of the door handle.

test2.ptxt: Hold the electrical key transmitter close to the electrical key antenna (inside the rear bumper) and check the smart lock <-> unlock operation from the back door.

atten3.ptxt: Communication is not possible within 20cm of the rear bumper.

test2.ptxt: Hold the electrical key transmitter close to the door control receiver and check the smart lock/unlock operation from the back door.

atten4.ptxt: If the inspection result shows that the system does not operate only at specific locations or times, radio interference is likely. Also, dealer-installed parts, etc. (mobile phone charger, power outlet [AC100V power supply], etc.) may cause radio interference, so if there are dealer-installed parts, remove them and check the operation.

test1.ptxt: Diagnosis Mode Inspection (Driver Side Outside Antenna)

test2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), select "Body" -> "Certification" -> "Electronic Key Diag Mode" -> "D Seat Transmission -> Interior Tuner".

Check that the wireless door lock buzzer sounds (beep, beep...) when the electrical key transmitter is held at the same height as the driver side door outside handle and approximately 70cm away from it.

test1.ptxt: Diagnosis Mode Inspection (Front Passenger Side Outside Antenna)

test2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), select "Body" -> "Certification" -> "Electronic Key Diag Mode" -> "P Seat Transmission -> Interior Tuner".

Check that the wireless door lock buzzer sounds (beep, beep...) when the electrical key transmitter is held at the same height as the front passenger side door outside handle and approximately 70cm away from it.
Using SST (TaSCAN), select "Diagnosis" -> "Body" -> "Certification" -> "Electronic Key Diag Mode" -> "Fr Seat Transmission -> Interior Tuner".
Check that the wireless door lock buzzer sounds (beep, beep...) when the electrical key transmitter is placed on the driver or front passenger seat cushion.
Using SST (TaSCAN), select "Diagnosis" -> "Body" -> "Certification" -> "Electronic Key Diag Mode" -> "Rr Seat Transmission -> Interior Tuner".
Check that the wireless door lock buzzer sounds (beep [continuous]) when the electrical key transmitter is placed on the rear seat cushion.

test1.ptxt: Diagnosis Mode Inspection (Luggage Compartment Outside Antenna)

test2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), select "Body" -> "Certification" -> "Electronic Key Diag Mode" -> "Back Door Outside Transmission -> Interior Tuner".

Check that the wireless door lock buzzer sounds (beep, beep...) when the electrical key transmitter is held at the center of the rear end of the vehicle, at the same height as the top of the rear bumper and approximately 70cm away from it.
